name: Calendar
summary: Month grid for picking a day, a range, or several days.

a11y.apg: grid. The engine ships the pattern: the month is a table with role=grid, every day is a real button inside a gridcell with aria-selected, the month name is announced through role=status aria-live, and the weekday header is aria-hidden because the day buttons already carry the full date in their label.
a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 27/08/2026 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). All ten declared keys were confirmed to move the focused day. The bank mounts with mode="single": without a mode, react-day-picker renders days as text in <td> and there is no button to focus.

props.name: mode
props.description: What a click does. `single` picks one day, `range` picks a start and an end, `multiple` collects days that need not touch.

props.name: selected
props.description: The current selection. Its shape follows `mode`.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the new selection. Without it the calendar is read-only, which is a legitimate use: a month with days marked.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Days that cannot be picked — a date, a range, `{before}`/`{after}`, weekdays, or a function. This is what a native date input cannot do, and the reason this component exists.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the whole calendar, for when the month name is not enough to tell it apart — two of them side by side would both announce "August 2026". Inside a popover the trigger already says it, so leave it out.

props.name: showOutsideDays
props.description: Fills the first and last week with the neighbouring month's days. On by default: a grid with holes at the edges shifts shape when the month changes.

props.name: …DayPicker
props.description: Everything else goes to the engine — `numberOfMonths`, `month`, `locale`, `weekStartsOn`, `fromDate`/`toDate`, `modifiers`. `classNames` merges over the Aurea names instead of replacing them.
